sources.title: DaVita Algorithm Flags Issues With Home Dialysis Patients
sources.snippet: As with all things in machine learning and AI, we will continue to iterate on this. But this model flags patients who are in the riskiest 10% and we know that if we do nothing for those patients, they are significantly more likely to fail at doing home dialysis and return to in-center hemodialysis.
